title: BeatsDiscoveryClaim
description: Attribution claim: the signer says they discovered a snapshot. Tracks are deterministic, so a discovery is a fact about who looked first, not an act of authorship. The claim carries attribution only; it conveys no ownership, and the snapshot stays CC0. First valid claim per snapshot wins, as ordered by the registry that accepts it (validFrom is self-asserted and is only checked for plausibility, never trusted for ordering).

discoverer.description: did:pkh of the signer; the verifier requires it to equal the address recovered from the envelope signature.

x-rules: registry resolves the claimed snapshot document and checks its CID before accepting

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
